title: Rework of held pull requests, proposed for a human merge
summary: A workflow started by a review that held: a Claude session that can only read and edit files fixes the blocking findings on a copy of the pull request's tree, and a job without Claude pushes one new branch and opens a pull request into the held one; two attempts, then needs-human.
postInstall: For a PRIVATE repository only: read docs/conventions/claude-rework.md first.
Create the repository label needs-human: after two attempts the rework adds it.
Never run live by the kit's authors: hold a throwaway pull request on purpose and read the first rework's run and pull request.
